vectors.description: A three-gradient template chain resolves attributes from the nearest template and stops from the base; templates are not written.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="base" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1" spreadMethod="repeat"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#000"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#fff"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="mid" xlink:href="#base" x2="1"/><linearGradient id="top" href="#mid" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"/><rect width="24" height="24" fill="url(#top)"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="p1" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1" spreadMethod="repeat">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="1"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="1"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="24" height="24" rx="0" ry="0" fill="url(#p1)" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: A radial gradient inherits stops and shared attributes, but not coordinates, from a linear template.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="l" x1="0.2" gradientTransform="rotate(90)"><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#abcdef"/></linearGradient><radialGradient id="r" href="#l" r="40%"/><circle cx="5" cy="5" r="5" fill="url(#r)"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="p1" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="40%" fx="50%" fy="50%" fr="0%" spreadMethod="pad" gradientTransform="rotate(90)">
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#abcdef" stop-opacity="1"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx="5" cy="5" r="5" fill="url(#p1)" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: A gradient fill inherited from a group is written on each primitive with the same ID.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#000"/></linearGradient><g fill="url(#g)"><path d="M0 0H1"/><path d="M0 0H2"/></g></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="p1" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%" spreadMethod="pad">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="1"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <g>
    <path d="M 0 0 H 1" fill="url(#p1)" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
    <path d="M 0 0 H 2" fill="url(#p1)" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>

vectors.description: The url function name matches case-insensitively and is written in lowercase.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g"/><path d="M0 0H1" fill="URL(#g)"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="p1" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%" spreadMethod="pad"/>
  </defs>
  <path d="M 0 0 H 1" fill="url(#p1)" stroke="none" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: Whitespace inside url() makes the URL part non-local.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g"/><path d="M0 0H1" fill="url( #g )"/></svg>

vectors.description: Defaults are written as their SVG percentage tokens even beside numeric user-space coordinates.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="2"/><radialGradient id="r" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" cx="4" r="3"/><path d="M0 0H1" fill="url(#g)" stroke="url(#r)"/></svg>

expect.canonical:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="p1" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="2" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%" spreadMethod="pad"/>
    <radialGradient id="p2" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" cx="4" cy="50%" r="3" fx="4" fy="50%" fr="0%" spreadMethod="pad"/>
  </defs>
  <path d="M 0 0 H 1" fill="url(#p1)" stroke="url(#p2)" stroke-width="1" opacity="1"/>
</svg>

vectors.description: A stop offset above 1 is refused rather than clamped.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g"><stop offset="1.5"/></linearGradient></svg>

vectors.description: A stop offset below 0% is refused.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g"><stop offset="-10%"/></linearGradient></svg>

vectors.description: Whitespace between a stop offset and % fails the percentage grammar.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g"><stop offset="50 %"/></linearGradient></svg>

vectors.description: A stop offset below the previous one is refused, comparing percentages as fractions.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g"><stop offset="50%"/><stop offset="0.4"/></linearGradient></svg>

vectors.description: A paint URL that names no element is refused.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M0 0H1" fill="url(#nope)"/></svg>

vectors.description: A paint URL must name a gradient.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><clipPath id="k"><rect width="1" height="1"/></clipPath><path d="M0 0H1" fill="url(#k)"/></svg>

vectors.description: A clip-path URL must name a clip path.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g"/><path d="M0 0H1" clip-path="url(#g)"/></svg>

vectors.description: A gradient template must be a gradient.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path id="p" d="M0 0H1"/><linearGradient id="g" href="#p"/><path d="M0 0H2" fill="url(#g)"/></svg>

vectors.description: A fragment of another document is refused.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M0 0H1" fill="url(other.svg#g)"/></svg>

vectors.description: Quoted URLs are refused; only the exact local form is admitted.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g"/><path d="M0 0H1" fill="url('#g')"/></svg>

vectors.description: Two elements with the same ID are refused.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="a"/><linearGradient id="a"/><path d="M0 0H1"/></svg>

vectors.description: Every reference is checked, even on clip geometry whose paint is discarded.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><clipPath id="k"><rect width="1" height="1" fill="url(#missing)"/></clipPath><path d="M0 0H1" clip-path="url(#k)"/></svg>

vectors.description: A gradient that is its own template is refused.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="g" href="#g"/><path d="M0 0H1" fill="url(#g)"/></svg>

vectors.description: A two-gradient template cycle is refused once.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="a" href="#b"/><linearGradient id="b" href="#a"/><path d="M0 0H1" fill="url(#a)"/></svg>

vectors.description: A cycle is refused even when nothing references it.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="a" href="#b"/><linearGradient id="b" href="#a"/><path d="M0 0H1"/></svg>

vectors.description: Clip paths cannot themselves be clipped.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><clipPath id="a"><rect width="1" height="1"/></clipPath><clipPath id="b" clip-path="url(#a)"><rect width="2" height="2"/></clipPath><path d="M0 0H1" clip-path="url(#b)"/></svg>

vectors.description: Clip geometry cannot carry clip-path.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><clipPath id="a"><rect width="1" height="1"/></clipPath><clipPath id="b"><rect width="2" height="2" clip-path="url(#a)"/></clipPath><path d="M0 0H1" clip-path="url(#b)"/></svg>

vectors.description: A clip path admits primitives only.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><clipPath id="k"><g><rect width="1" height="1"/></g></clipPath><path d="M0 0H1" clip-path="url(#k)"/></svg>

vectors.description: href is admitted only on gradients.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M0 0H1" href="#x"/></svg>

vectors.description: A gradient cannot carry both href and xlink:href.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><linearGradient id="a"/><linearGradient id="g" href="#a" xlink:href="#a"/></svg>

vectors.description: An ID must match the id grammar.
vectors.input: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path id="1 2" d="M0 0H1"/></svg>
